prompts.planets-variants: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: VORO game distant background texture atlas. Generate a 1536x1024 PNG (or larger exact 3:2 ratio). EXACTLY FOUR rectangular landscape panels in a perfectly equal 2x2 grid, each panel exactly half width and half height. No gutters, no borders, no margins, no frames, no labels. All four panels extend fully to their edges. Each panel is an independent full-bleed background variant. Naturalistic detailed painted cinematic cosmic art with subtle organic nonuniform textures. Primarily VERY DARK NAVY nearly black, very low contrast, dim subdued atmospheric accents, quiet enough for bright foreground game objects. No large stars, planets, moons, galaxies, celestial discs or identifiable individual objects, no flares, no bright focal objects. A few faint tiny distant points of starlight allowed. No horizon, text, UI, diagrams, geometric patterns or watermark. Bottom-right panel must be a complete painted environment with its own subtle details. Distant interplanetary space. TOP LEFT: cool sparse stardust, faint wispy blue-gray particles in black navy. TOP RIGHT: faint amber diffuse dust band crossing at an organic oblique angle, dark muted ochre against navy. BOTTOM LEFT: very faint teal gaseous haze in uneven natural layers. BOTTOM RIGHT: near-black quiet space, extremely subtle deep blue speckled dust and sparse tiny distant points.
